title: Bay Status
description: A bay status as it appears on the wire: the six REPORTABLE states. The bay state machine has seven states -- `Unknown` is the seventh and is deliberately absent here, because no party transmits it. See Chapter 05 -- State Machines, section 2.2. A type generated from this schema MUST NOT gain `Unknown` back: an implementation may hold it internally, but the type used for a wire status field must not be able to express it, or typed code that compiles can construct a message this schema rejects.
